name: grid
title: Grid Background
description: A near-black backdrop ruled with fine squares, softened at the border by a radial fade, with one gradient heading floating in the centre.
use: A dark landing or section needs quiet texture behind a headline without images or animation.
avoid: The page must stay light, or busy artwork already fills the hero and the lines would fight it.
a11y: A decorative backdrop with a text heading only; there is no control, so keyboard, focus and labels do not apply. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A black rectangle filled with a faint 40px lattice of thin grey lines, strongest in the middle and dying to pure black at the edges. A single large word, shaded from pale grey at the top to mid-grey below, sits centred.
behaves: Static: nothing animates or responds. The ruling, the edge fade and the heading are drawn once and stay fixed.
customise: Takes no props. Heading text, square size, line opacity and the edge mask all live in the source, so changing them means editing the file.
weight: light: A couple of divs and plain CSS gradients; nothing animates or repaints.
demo: The word "Backgrounds" set as a large gradient heading.
issues: Root hardcodes a black background, so it will not fit light themes.
The heading is baked into the component, not passed in.
polishWhy: Even ruling and a smooth edge fade; contrast at the corners is low by design.
